dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a measure μ and real-valued functions X and Y, this is the integral of the ordered product (X(ω) − ∫X dμ)(Y(ω) − ∫Y dμ).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the left side of the first equality and makes that equality identify the defined centered mixed moment with its displayed integral formula.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real-valued function X, this is the totalized Bochner integral ∫ X dμ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines every mean and every displayed integral in the two equalities, including the means subtracted from X and Y.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: For real-valued functions X and Y, this is the integral ∫ X(ω)Y(ω) dμ of their ordered pointwise product.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to the centered X-function first and centered Y-function second, it supplies the right side of the second equality.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects an additive commutative monoid-with-one structure to an additive monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass plumbing used to interpret the exponent literal 2 in ENNReal and adds no independent mathematical assertion.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the natural-number casting operation from an additive monoid-with-one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports casting the natural number 2 into ENNReal for the MemLp exponent.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires both displayed real-number equalities simultaneously, rather than offering alternatives.

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousENorm.toENorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts an extended-norm structure from a continuous extended-norm structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the real-valued ENorm instance used when interpreting the two MemLp hypotheses.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of extended nonnegative real numbers, NNReal with a top element ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exponent and extended-norm codomain used by MemLp; the exponent is the finite value 2.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is propositional equality between two terms of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each conjunct an exact equality of real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is heterogeneous multiplication supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real instances selected here, it forms the ordered real product of the centered X factor and then the centered Y factor.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is heterogeneous subtraction supplied by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real instances selected here, it forms X(ω) − ∫X dμ and Y(ω) − ∫Y dμ.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips Ω with a measurable-space, or sigma-algebra, structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines which subsets and functions are measurable and is required to form μ, MemLp, and the integrals.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proposition/typeclass says that μ is a probability measure, in particular that μ assigns total mass one to the whole space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts μ to a probability measure, so the integrals used as means are expectations without an additional normalization factor.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of measures on the given measurable space Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the measure μ with respect to which all L2 conditions, means, and product integrals are taken.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.MemLp
dependency_coverage.meaning: MemLp f p μ means that f is almost-everywhere strongly measurable and its Lp extended seminorm is strictly below ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For p = 2, it assumes separately that X and Y are real-valued L2 representatives with respect to μ.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the source numeral used to construct the exponent 2 in ENNReal.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that a successor of a nonzero natural number is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies evidence that the natural literal 2 is at least two, enabling its generic cast into ENNReal.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that every natural-number successor is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is auxiliary typeclass evidence used in constructing the numeral 2 and has no separate effect on the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates in deriving the real seminormed additive and norm structures needed by MemLp; it imposes no additional hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts a seminormed additive commutative group from a nonunital seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes the standard real normed-additive structure used to interpret MemLp.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the typeclass path furnishing the standard extended norm and topology on Real for MemLp.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace

dependency_coverage.name: Real

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard multiplication operation on real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard subtraction operation on real numbers, defined as addition of the additive inverse.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard normed commutative ring structure on Real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard pseudometric structure on Real, with distance |x − y|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes the standard uniform and topological structures used by MemLp.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets additive commutativity from a seminormed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass plumbing in the construction of Real's continuous extended norm for MemLp.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the pseudometric structure from a seminormed additive group.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets the multiplicative unit from a seminormed commutative ring.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the standard topological-space instance on Real required by MemLp.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddCommMonoidWithOneENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard additive commutative monoid-with-one structure on ENNReal.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns an ordinary multiplication operation into homogeneous heterogeneous multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given natural-number casting and evidence that n is at least two, this provides an OfNat instance whose value is the cast of n.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup

binders: A typeclass witness that μ is a probability measure.
Two actual functions X,Y : Ω → ℝ.
A proof hX that X belongs to L2(μ) in the MemLp sense.
A proof hY that Y belongs to L2(μ) in the MemLp sense.
hypotheses: X is almost-everywhere strongly measurable and has finite L2 extended seminorm with respect to μ.
Y is almost-everywhere strongly measurable and has finite L2 extended seminorm with respect to μ.
conclusions: Let mX = ∫ X dμ and mY = ∫ Y dμ. The quantity LocalDef001 μ X Y is exactly ∫ (X(ω) − mX)(Y(ω) − mY) dμ(ω).
The same integral ∫ (X(ω) − mX)(Y(ω) − mY) dμ(ω) is exactly LocalDef003 μ (ω ↦ X(ω) − mX) (ω ↦ Y(ω) − mY), namely the integral of the pointwise product of those two centered functions.
mathematical_definitions: For any actual function f : Ω → ℝ, define Iμ(f) = ∫ f dμ using Mathlib's totalized Bochner integral.
Define mX = Iμ(X) and mY = Iμ(Y).
Define the centered representatives Xc(ω) = X(ω) − mX and Yc(ω) = Y(ω) − mY.
LocalDef001 μ X Y = Iμ(ω ↦ Xc(ω)Yc(ω)).
LocalDef003 μ f g = Iμ(ω ↦ f(ω)g(ω)).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every probability measure μ on a measurable space Ω and every pair of real-valued L2 functions X and Y, both of the following equalities hold: LocalDef001 μ X Y equals the integral of the ordered centered product (X − ∫X dμ)(Y − ∫Y dμ), and that very integral equals LocalDef003 applied first to X − ∫X dμ and second to Y − ∫Y dμ. Equivalently, the proposition asserts the full three-term equality LocalDef001 μ X Y = ∫ (X(ω) − ∫X dμ)(Y(ω) − ∫Y dμ) dμ(ω) = LocalDef003 μ (X − ∫X dμ) (Y − ∫Y dμ), encoded as a conjunction of its two adjacent equalities.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The statement concerns concrete representatives X,Y : Ω → ℝ, not elements of a quotient L2 space, although MemLp and integration are insensitive to almost-everywhere changes where their usual hypotheses apply.

All integrals are Mathlib's totalized Bochner integral. Thus the definitions have a value even on nonintegrable inputs, conventionally zero; the proposition itself does not replace that operation by a partial integral.
The factor order is preserved throughout: the centered X value is multiplied on the left by the centered Y value on the right.
The exponent in both MemLp assumptions is the finite ENNReal value 2.
The two conclusions are exact equalities in ℝ, not almost-everywhere equalities of functions.
The probability-measure instance supplies total mass one; no extra division by μ(Ω) occurs in the means.
No independence, identical distribution, zero covariance, nonzero variance, or probabilistic relationship between X and Y is assumed or concluded.

The theorem is only instantiated when the supplied μ has an IsProbabilityMeasure witness; on any measurable type admitting no such measure the universal statement has no applicable μ-instance and is vacuous there.

The L2 assumptions are explicit even though both asserted equalities directly unfold the supplied definitions; the proposition does not state a separate integrability lemma or expose any proof that the centered product is integrable.
